A sudden sinkhole opened up in the karst landscape as acidic groundwater completely collapsed the limestone cavern roof. (酸性地下水使石灰岩洞穴頂部完全塌陷，喀斯特地形中因而突然出現塌陷洞。)
Polynesian voyagers carried breadfruit seedlings with them on their long sea migrations. (玻里尼西亞航海者長途渡海遷徙時，帶著麵包果幼苗同行。)
The fragile transitional theropod fossil was fortuitously unearthed when road builders split an unaltered shale bedrock layer. (道路施工者劈開一層頁岩時，意外挖出了脆弱的過渡型獸腳類恐龍化石。)
In pure geometry, an equilateral triangle is a polygon containing three interior angles that measure exactly sixty degrees. (在純幾何學中，等邊三角形是一個包含三個內角皆為精確六十度的多邊形。)
The predatory osprey utilizes a localized thermal updraft to glide effortlessly above ocean surfaces while searching for fish. (魚鷹利用局部熱氣流，在搜尋魚群時輕鬆滑翔於海面上空。)
Bituminous coal is a dense carboniferous sedimentary rock extensively utilized for industrial electricity generation. (煙煤是一種密實的含碳沉積岩，廣泛用於工業發電。)
The geological expedition mapped the arid vegetation thriving across the rocky tableland of the canyon. (地質考察隊繪製了在這片峽谷岩石台地上茂盛生長的乾旱植被圖。)
The moth features a colorful geometric underwing pattern that is hidden during rest but flashed abruptly to disrupt predatory birds. (這種蛾以色彩斑斕的幾何後翅圖案為特色，在休息時會隱藏，但會突然閃現以干擾捕食性鳥類。)
Historically, a ship chandler was responsible for supplying vessels with essential provisions before long voyages. (在歷史上，船舶雜貨商負責在遠航前為船隻供應必要的物資。)
The pest control professionals had to completely fumigate the apartment building to eradicate the termite infestation. (除蟲專業人員必須對整棟公寓大樓進行全面煙燻消毒，以根除白蟻帶來的危害。)
Persistent polar aridity forces tundra plants to grow low and close to the ground. (極地長期乾燥，迫使凍原植物長得低矮、貼近地面。)
The indigenous population managed the limited agricultural water resources communally to ensure long-term fairness. (原住民群體共同管理有限的農業水資源，以確保長期的公平。)
The construction firm was penalized for its slapdash repair work on the historic public bridge. (該建築公司因對這座歷史悠久的公共橋梁進行粗製濫造的修復工程而受罰。)
Environmental engineers detected minor toxic chemical seepage from the underground storage tank into the local aquifer. (環境工程師偵測到地下儲槽中的有毒化學物質輕微滲漏至當地含水層。)

meaning: adv. 色彩鮮豔地、生動地
example: The traditional festival participants were colorfully dressed in embroidered garments that reflected their ancestry. (傳統節慶的參與者穿著色彩鮮豔、反映自身祖源的刺繡服飾。)
Glacial erosion reshapes the landscape, converting a narrow river valley into a massive, U-shaped landform. (冰河侵蝕重塑了地貌，將狹窄的河谷轉化為巨大的U型地形。)
A thick bedcover of fine volcanic ash completely enclosed the ancient metropolis, preserving structural masonry walls perfectly. (一層厚厚的細火山灰完全覆蓋這座古代都市，並將石造牆體保存得十分完好。)

meaning: adv. 在地形上；就地勢而言
example: Topographically, the region is characterized by steep, rugged mountains and narrow valley floors. (在地形上，該地區的特徵是陡峭崎嶇的山脈與狹窄的谷底。)
The flat plains of the Midwest are covered with thick, fertile loess deposited by wind after the ice age. (中西部平坦的平原覆蓋著厚實肥沃的黃土，是冰河期後由風吹積而成。)

meaning: adj. 平版印刷的；（半導體）微影的
example: Modern semiconductor manufacturing relies on advanced lithographic processes to print microchips. (現代半導體製造依賴先進的微影製程來印製微晶片。)

meaning: adj. 雙焦距的（如雙光眼鏡）
example: Early optical craftspeople engineered bifocal lenses to correct both near and distant vision. (早期的光學工匠設計出雙焦距鏡片，同時矯正近視與遠視。)
Geographers mapping nineteenth-century hospitals cataloged mass-produced ceramic bedpans. (繪製十九世紀醫院分布圖的地理學家，記錄了大量生產的陶瓷便盆。)
The lithospheric plates float upon the semi-fluid asthenosphere, driven by deep mantle convection. (岩石圈板塊漂浮在半流動的軟流圈之上，受到深層地函對流的驅動。)
Weavers extracted natural dyestuffs from plants to dye raw wool a vivid magenta. (織工從植物中提取天然染料，把原色羊毛染成鮮豔的洋紅色。)
A bovine ruminant continuously chews its cud to facilitate the bacterial breakdown of rigid plant cellulose. (牛科反芻動物不斷地咀嚼牠的反芻食物，以促進細菌分解僵硬的植物纖維素。)
Wild huckleberry shrubs thrive in the acidic soils of northern temperate forests, providing vital summer food for bears. (野生越橘灌木在北方溫帶森林的酸性土壤中茂盛生長，為熊提供了至關重要的夏季食物。)

meaning: adj. 過於自信的；自負的
example: Speculators who grew overconfident about railway land in the Midwest later faced ruinous losses. (對中西部鐵路用地過於自信的投機客，後來遭受毀滅性的損失。)
The traditional herbalist utilized distilled balsam to formulate a soothing ointment for skin irritations. (傳統草藥醫生利用蒸餾香脂，調配出一種用於緩解皮膚過敏的舒緩軟膏。)
The building collapsed because it was constructed on unconsolidated soil. (建築物倒塌是因為它建在鬆散的土壤上。)
The sensitive seismograph recorded minor tectonic vibrations hours before the major earthquake occurred. (在主震發生前數小時，敏感的地震儀就記錄到了輕微的構造震動。)
The academician presented isotope data that supported the climate model based on ice cores. (這位院士展示了支持冰芯氣候模型的同位素資料。)

meaning: n. 編劇才華；舞台藝術；編劇/導演技巧
example: Early Broadway theater operators used automated lighting and sophisticated stagecraft to heighten the dramatic effect of musicals. (早期百老匯劇院經營者運用自動照明與精湛的舞台技術，提升音樂劇的戲劇效果。)

meaning: n. 多愁善感；感情用事
example: Critics argued that the film relied too heavily on cheap sentimentalism rather than a compelling, logical plot. (評論家認為這部電影過於依賴廉價的情感渲染，而不是引人入勝且具邏輯性的劇情。)
Ethology focuses on observing species-specific actions inside natural settings to track evolutionary adaptation traits. (動物行為學專注於在自然環境中觀察物種特有的行為，以追蹤演化適應特徵。)
Early nineteenth-century textile factories were located near fast-flowing rivers to directly exploit mechanical waterpower. (十九世紀早期的紡織工廠位於流速快的河流附近，以直接利用機械水力。)
The high structural rigidity of the protective skeleton shell maximizes the marine invertebrate's tidal survivability. (堅硬的保護性骨殼，提升了海洋無脊椎動物在潮間帶的生存能力。)
Chemical weathering accelerates when carbonic acid inside falling rainwater dissolves limestone rock structures. (當落下雨水內部的碳酸溶解石灰岩岩石結構時，化學風化作用會加速。)

meaning: n. 外包工作；家庭代工
example: Before industrial centralization in factories, merchant capitalists distributed raw textiles via the outwork system. (在工廠的工業集中化之前，商業資本家透過家庭代工系統來分發紡織原料。)

meaning: n. 叢林居民；布希曼人
example: The cultural anthropologist studied how the African bushman hunter groups traced animal footprints across arid sands. (文化人類學家研究非洲布希曼狩獵群體如何在乾旱沙地追蹤動物足跡。)

meaning: adj. 直言不諱的；坦率的
example: The rural politician's plainspoken communication style resonated deeply with working-class community voters. (這位鄉村政治人物直言不諱的溝通風格，深深引起了工人階級社區選民的共鳴。)
Nineteenth-century agrarian orchard farmers fermented surplus pears to manufacture an alcoholic beverage called perry. (十九世紀的果農將多餘的梨子發酵，製成一種名為梨子酒的酒精飲料。)

meaning: n. 陸地居民；外行的水手
example: The historical maritime geographer analyzed registries separating the oceanic seafarer cohort from the sedentary landsman tier. (歷史海洋地理學家分析了相關名冊，將航海者與定居的陸地居民區分開來。)
Biologists studied the locomotor mechanics of cheetahs to understand how their bone architecture facilitates extreme speed. (生物學家研究了獵豹的運動力學，以了解其骨骼結構如何促進極限速度。)

meaning: n. 籃筐編織業；編籃工藝
example: Ancestral pueblo communities excelled in handcraft basketry, using woven wetland reed stalks to manufacture dry storage urns. (祖先普韋布洛人擅長編籃，使用編織的濕地蘆葦製作乾燥物品的儲藏甕。)
The local landholder negotiated a comprehensive conservation easement to protect the wetlands from commercial development. (當地地主協商了一份全面的保育役權，以保護濕地免受商業開發。)
Paleolithic humans relied predominantly on hunting and gathering, using basic stone tools for survival. (舊石器時代的人類主要依賴狩獵和採集，使用基本的石器來生存。)
Some students thrived under the strict regimentation of the military academy, while others found it stifling. (有些學生在軍事學校的嚴格管教下表現出色，而另一些人則覺得壓抑。)
The local museum featured a stunning exhibition of traditional indigenous woodcarving masterworks. (當地博物館展出了傳統原住民木雕大師傑作的精采展覽。)

meaning: adj. 記憶力強的、具保持力的
example: An exceptionally retentive mind allowed the historian to recall precise dates and obscure diplomatic documents. (異常強大的記憶力讓這位歷史學家能夠回想起精確的日期和晦澀的外交文件。)
The white dogwood is a common broadleaf angiosperm tree that thrives inside the cool understory of temperate woodland landscapes. (白茱萸是常見的闊葉被子植物，生長於溫帶林地涼爽的林下環境。)
Louis Pasteur developed the thermal process of pasteurization to eliminate pathogenic bacteria from milk products. (路易斯·巴斯德研發了巴氏殺菌的熱處理方法，用以消除乳製品中的病原菌。)
A filmy layer of morning mist hung low over the surface of the lake, obscuring the distant shoreline. (薄薄一層如膜般的晨霧低低地懸掛在湖面上，遮蔽了遙遠的海岸線。)
The theater underwent an extensive architectural renovation to optimize its internal acoustical properties. (該劇院經歷了廣泛的建築翻新，以優化其內部的聲學特性。)
The trace inclusions of volatile sulfate molecules were found diffusely distributed inside the sedimentary page rock matrix. (揮發性硫酸鹽分子的微量內含物，被發現分散於沉積頁岩中。)
Before applying tempera paint, the Renaissance artist covered the wooden panel with a smooth layer of gesso. (在上蛋彩顏料之前，文藝復興畫家先在木板上塗一層平滑的石膏底料。)

meaning: n. 立足點；（攀岩）腳踏處
example: Lichens gain a toehold in tiny cracks in granite and slowly break the rock down. (地衣在花崗岩的細小裂縫中取得立足點，慢慢分解岩石。)
The exceptional metallurgical malleability of copper allowed Bronze Age craftspeople to hammer crude ores into ornate figurines. (銅優異的冶金延展性，容許青銅時代的手工藝人將粗糙的礦石錘打成華麗的小雕像。)
The physicists utilized a highly advanced laser interferometer to detect subtle gravitational waves in deep space. (物理學家利用高度先進的雷射干涉儀來探測深空中的微弱重力波。)

meaning: n. 造船工匠；造船廠工人
example: The expert Polynesian shipwright handcrafted the stable outrigger watercraft utilizing split cedar logs and rawhide. (這位玻里尼西亞造船工匠利用劈開的雪松原木與生牛皮，手工打造穩固的舷外浮桿船。)
The rapid mountain stream deposits coarse gravel and boulders along its rugged erosion-carved streambed profile. (急促的山區溪流沿著其崎嶇、受侵蝕雕琢的河床輪廓，沉積下粗糙的礫石與巨石。)
Germanium is a vital metalloid semiconductor crystal utilized inside advanced optics and early electronics industry designs. (鍺是一種至關重要的類金屬半導體晶體，用於先進光學與早期電子產業設計中。)

meaning: n. 地方風尚；偏狹；地方主義
example: The cultural diffusion of centralized metropolitan text legal networks worked to eliminate rural tribal provincialism. (中央集權的大都市文字與法律網絡傳播，有助於消除農村部落的地方主義。)
